 This Criminal Petition Is Filed Under Section 482
Cr.P.C Praying To Quash The Entire Proceedings In
C.C.No.18183/2018 Which Is Pending On The File Of The
Chief Metropolitan Magistrate Court, Bangalore.

This Petition, Coming On For Admission, This Day,
The Court Made The Following:
 Order

The accused No.1 has been charge sheeted for the offences under Sections 498A, 504, 506, 34 of IPC alleging that the defacto complainant is legally wedded wife of accused No.1 and she was subjected to cruelty, both mentally and physically.
The cognizance taken by the learned Magistrate for the aforesaid offences is impugned in this petition.

2. The father of accused No.1, Sri R Nagaraj, learned counsel appearing for the petitioner and also the defacto complainant are present before this Court and they have submitted a joint memo by way of affidavit stating that the parties have amicably settled the dispute among themselves and the defacto complainant has no objection for quashing the impugned proceeding.
3. The joint memo is placed on record.

4. Though the offences alleged are cognizable and non-compoundable, however, having regard to the fact that the parties have amicably settled the dispute among themselves, it will be a futile exercise, if the petitioner - accused is subjected to trial, since the probability of his conviction is remote and bleak in view of the settlement arrived between the parties.

Accordingly, I pass the following:
ORDER i) Criminal petition is allowed.
